corpus.commit_subject: Fix upgrade batch (#655)
corpus.defect_summary: BatchHeaderCodecV0.loadAndValidate required exact equality length == BATCH_HEADER_LENGTH (249) instead of length >= BATCH_HEADER_LENGTH, rejecting valid upgraded batch headers with trailing data.

corpus.commit_subject: Fix commitBatchWithProof by any (#906)
corpus.defect_summary: Rollup._commitBatchWithBatchData queried getStakerBitmap(_msgSender()) unconditionally even when called from commitBatchWithProof by a non-staker prover, misattributing the submitter staker bitmap.

corpus.commit_subject: prevent overflow
corpus.defect_summary: L1Staking.slash iterated over sequencers without skipping zero addresses and subtracted withdrawals from undelegated stake without guarding against underflow.

corpus.commit_subject: fix(common): bound RLP transaction allocations (#1028)
corpus.defect_summary: extractInnerTxFullBytes allocated a slice of attacker-controlled RLP header size before checking whether size exceeded the remaining bytes in the batch reader.

corpus.commit_subject: fix(tx-submitter): finalize lastFinalized+1 instead of skipping via p… (#1065)
corpus.defect_summary: Rollup.finalize advanced target batch index from pendingTxs.GetPFinalize() + 1 instead of lastFinalized + 1, skipping an unfinalized batch after a dropped or failed finalize transaction.

corpus.commit_subject: Fix executeValidatePreimage to match Rust prover validation (#398)
corpus.defect_summary: OneStepProverHostIo.executeValidatePreimage failed to enforce the u8 domain bound (preimageType <= 255) and valid enum range (< 4) before accessing moduleMemory.

corpus.commit_subject: arbwasm: fix mininitgas return types
corpus.defect_summary: ArbWasm.minInitGas declared uint8 return types for gas and cached instead of uint64, truncating minimum initialization gas values across the precompile ABI.

corpus.commit_subject: Fixed strick equality
corpus.defect_summary: RoundTimingInfoLib checked strict equality latestResolvedRound == curRound + 1 instead of >= curRound + 1, failing to reject rounds resolved further ahead of curRound + 1.

corpus.commit_subject: fix: loop length
corpus.defect_summary: CacheManager iterated i < k instead of i < kbids.length when populating the Entry[] result slice, reading out of bounds when kbids had fewer than k elements.

corpus.commit_subject: feat: check node hash in fast confirmation
corpus.defect_summary: AbsRollupUserLogic.fastConfirmNextNode confirmed the next unresolved node using only blockHash and sendRoot without verifying nodeHash equality against firstUnresolvedNode(), unlike standard confirmation.

corpus.commit_subject: contracts-bedrock: check pause after early return in SuperFaultDisputeGame.closeGame (#23267)
corpus.defect_summary: SuperFaultDisputeGame.closeGame checked anchorStateRegistry().paused() before the early-return bond distribution state check, preventing read-only game closure reconciliation when paused.

corpus.commit_subject: contracts-bedrock: fix standard validation of migrated interop members (#23134)
corpus.defect_summary: OPContractsManagerStandardValidator validated shared DisputeGameFactory and AnchorStateRegistry contracts against the per-chain _proxyAdmin instead of the shared interop ProxyAdmin owner.

corpus.commit_subject: fix(l2cm): revert instead of silently skipping non-upgradeable predeploys (#19798)
corpus.defect_summary: L2ContractsManagerUtils silently skipped non-upgradeable predeploys during upgrade instead of reverting, leaving unupgraded predeploy implementations active without discharging the upgrade precondition.

corpus.commit_subject: op-node: Bound the EL-sync safe label by the verified head (#22986)
corpus.defect_summary: EngineController.insertUnsafePayload assigned fc.SafeBlockHash = safeRef.Hash (local-safe) directly without bounding it by the verified cross-safe head e.SafeL2Head().

corpus.commit_subject: op-node: ignore stale sequencer action after Stop (#21690)
corpus.defect_summary: Sequencer.onSequencerAction processed queued SequencerActionEvent callbacks even after d.active was set to false by Stop, executing block building while inactive.

corpus.commit_subject: fix(protocol): make SGX MRENCLAVE/MRSIGNER untrust permanent (no silent revival) (#21894)
corpus.defect_summary: SgxVerifier allowed a previously untrusted MRENCLAVE or MRSIGNER to be re-trusted via setMrEnclave/setMrSigner, silently reviving SGX instances whose enclave measurement had been revoked.

corpus.commit_subject: fix(protocol): reject SGX instance ids that overflow the uint32 proof field (#21892)
corpus.defect_summary: SgxVerifier assigned uint256 nextInstanceId without bounding it to type(uint32).max, even though verifyProof decodes instance ids as uint32.

corpus.commit_subject: fix(protocol): remove _nextProposalId and _lastProposalBlockId from Inbox.init2 (#21838)
corpus.defect_summary: Inbox.init2 accepted external _nextProposalId and _lastProposalBlockId parameters and overwrote core state, breaking proposal ID continuity across post-incident re-initialization.

corpus.commit_subject: fix(protocol): prevent quota issuance overflow in QuotaManager (#21841)
corpus.defect_summary: QuotaManager.availableQuota multiplied q.quota * (block.timestamp + _leap - q.updatedAt) before capping elapsed time at quotaPeriod, risking arithmetic overflow for large _leap or elapsed intervals.

corpus.commit_subject: fix(taiko-client): roll back proposal cursors so failed proposals are re-scanned (#21951)
corpus.defect_summary: ProposalEventHandler.handleProposal logged errors without rolling back sharedState proposal cursors, causing failed proposals to be permanently skipped by periodic re-scans.
